proof_body:
by
  intro K _ _ I hI
  have hI' : I ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) := mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hI
  have hp : I ^ NumberField.classNumber K ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) := pow_mem hI' _
  rw [← ClassGroup.mk0_eq_one_iff hp]
  have : (⟨I ^ NumberField.classNumber K, hp⟩ : nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))) = ⟨I, hI'⟩ ^ NumberField.classNumber K := rfl
  rw [this, map_pow, NumberField.classNumber, pow_card_eq_one]
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (I : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)), I ≠ ⊥ → Submodule.IsPrincipal (I ^ NumberField.classNumber K)
